title: Intermediate term record (pipeline)
description: Superset of TermDef (src/content/terms.ts) plus pipeline metadata. The metadata fields (provenance, confidence, reviewStatus, sourceStale) are DROPPED on emit; the remainder maps 1:1 onto TermDef and becomes a value in public/terms.json.

id.description: Term id; the object key in terms.json. Sourced from chapter [[id|...]] references.

latex.description: → TermDef.latex — numeric facts from Wikidata; must KaTeX-parse

seeAlso.description: → TermDef.seeAlso — every id must exist in the final term set (validated)

provenance.description: DROPPED on emit. Drives attribution / credits surface (CC BY-SA).

revidEn.description: Exact Wikipedia revision id used (attribution points here)

confidence.description: DROPPED on emit. Drives low-confidence flags (§5.4).

numericMatch.description: true if numbers match Wikidata where checkable

reviewStatus.description: DROPPED on emit. Only 'approved'/'revised' are eligible for human merge.

sourceStale.description: DROPPED on emit. true when EN changed and IT not yet re-synced (EN/IT lock-step).
